question: Should this first-party Wear release land as one combined phone-bridge, watch-app, and publishing change after the identified validation, release, and security-scan blockers are fixed?
rationale: The PR creates a new authenticated remote-control surface and a new Google Play form factor; the protected maintainer signal means acceptance of that combined security and release boundary requires explicit owner judgment.

options.title: Fix and prove before merge
options.body: Keep this PR canonical, repair all five blockers, refresh from main, and require exact-head paired-device and release-preflight evidence before landing.

options.title: Split publishing from runtime
options.body: Land the phone/watch runtime only after validation and security coverage are complete, then add Play upload and listing assets in a separately reviewed release PR.

options.title: Pause the combined change
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and pause this branch if maintainers prefer smaller independently landable stages.

recommendation.title: Fix and prove before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR canonical, repair all five blockers, refresh from main, and require exact-head paired-device and release-preflight evidence before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: They established the first-party Wear direction and have the strongest prior history across the protocol, Android application, and release integration.
